title: Uniqueness of encoded shape parameters
statement: If a bit string has the prescribed shape for natural-number parameters $n,s,t$ and also for $n',s',t'$, then $n=n'$, $s=s'$, and $t=t'$.
hypotheses_covered: the string has shape for n, s, and t
the string has shape for n', s', and t'
